summary: Frontend regression on Tapi Namastubhyam site targeting three reported bug fixes: Members redesign for 7 people, Hero fits one screen, Daily Aarti schedule times visible. All three fixes verified via Playwright with reduced-motion emulation. Booking/Donate routes load cleanly (deep regression previously verified in iteration 1).
critical_code_review_comments: Members: 7 people rendered correctly. Featured card (Krunal Kamleshbhai Sailor) uses /members/krunal.jpg (naturalWidth=484). Grid member-0..member-4 use real photos (naturalWidth 672-900). member-5 (Paresh Mistry) correctly falls back to Monogram SVG (initials 'PM') since photo string is empty — no broken image icon shown.
Hero fits viewport at both 1440x800 (statsBottom=747 <= 800) and 1366x768 (statsBottom=742 <= 768). Stats strip fully visible within the initial screen with a small buffer for the 'Scroll' hint.
Daily Aarti schedule card is now dark (bg-ink/55 backdrop-blur-md) with gold times rendered in rgb(212,175,55) at opacity 1 — all three rows (6:00 AM, Sunset, 7:00 PM) are clearly legible.
Non-blocking: Hero image (yImg parallax transform) is at z-0 inside a section with paper background — verified visible.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use await page.emulate_media(reduced_motion='reduce') to bypass Lenis smooth-scroll. For scrolling to sections use element.scrollIntoView({behavior:'instant', block:'start'}) then wait ~1500ms. Member photos at /app/frontend/public/members/*.jpg (6 files) — Paresh Mistry intentionally has no photo and uses Monogram fallback. Booking + donation flows were confirmed end-to-end in iteration_1; this iteration only sanity-checked page loads for those routes.
rca of the issue: N/A — all three reported bugs are resolved. RCA of prior state: (1) Members section previously lacked real photos and layout for 7; fixed by featured + 3x2 grid with Monogram fallback for the missing photo. (2) Hero exceeded viewport due to large paddings/type; reduced pt/pb, tightened headline to lg:text-[5.75rem] and stats padding — now fits. (3) Aarti schedule times were low-contrast because card used light glass on lit hero image; changed to dark bg-ink/55 backdrop-blur-md giving strong contrast for the gold time text.
